findings.evidence: The tree contains `Bernoulli.lean` plus `Bernoulli/Measurability.lean`, `Cauchy.lean` plus `Cauchy/{Measurability,PDF}.lean`, `Exponential.lean` plus `Exponential/{Measurability,PDF}.lean`, `Geometric.lean` plus `Geometric/Measurability.lean`, and `Pareto.lean` plus `Pareto/{Measurability,PDF}.lean`; established multi-file families such as Beta and Binomial use `Foo/Basic.lean`.
findings.fix: Move each flat family module to `Foo/Basic.lean`, update all in-repository imports, and delete the old module paths.
findings.issue: Bernoulli, Cauchy, Exponential, Geometric, and Pareto are each split between `Distributions/Foo.lean` and new `Distributions/Foo/…` modules instead of placing the family under one topic directory.

summary: Five newly split family APIs leave their original family module flat beside a same-topic directory, producing inconsistent module homes.
